2608.28312.title: AIM: Anchor Identity Features, Then Match for Multimodal Large Language Model Unlearning
2608.28312.paper_summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can memorize identity-specific facts about people in their fine-tuning data, creating privacy risks when a person requests deletion. Existing MLLM unlearning methods often assume access to retain images or ground-truth answers during deletion, which is unrealistic in many practical scenarios. We study identity unlearning when retain images are unavailable at deletion time. Our analysis shows that identity and visual-perception questions occupy distinct regions in fine-tuned hidden states and are organized differently: identity questions cluster by person, whereas perception questions cluster by question type. This suggests that identity knowledge can be suppressed without erasing general visual perception. Building on this observation, we propose AIM, a two-stage method that anchors an identity-forgetting target with a universal visual prompt and then matches the vision encoder to that target under a Fisher-based constraint. Extensive experiments show that AIM achieves competitive identity forgetting while preserving non-deleted identities, prior knowledge, and visual perception on the same images.
2608.28312.paper_summary_zh: 多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）可以記住有關人員的特定身份事實，這些事實來自其微調數據，當某人請求刪除時，會產生隱私風險。現有的MLLM遺忘方法通常假設在刪除過程中可以訪問保留的圖像或真實答案，這在許多實際情況下是不切實際的。我們研究在刪除時無法獲得保留圖像的身份遺忘情況。我們的分析顯示，身份和視覺感知問題在微調的隱藏狀態中佔據不同的區域，並且組織方式不同：身份問題按人群聚集，而感知問題則按問題類型聚集。這表明身份知識可以被抑制，而不必抹去一般的視覺感知。基於這一觀察，我們提出了AIM，一種兩階段的方法，通過通用的視覺提示來固定身份遺忘目標，然後在基於Fisher的約束下將視覺編碼器與該目標匹配。大量實驗表明，AIM在保留未刪除身份、先前知識和相同圖像上的視覺感知的同時，實現了具有競爭力的身份遺忘。
